title: Camp Tekakwitha

services.name: day camp
services.desc: gives us the special opportunity to bring the Camp experience to YOU, right in your communities! Sessions will be hosted in various Diocesan parishes and will include camp programming unique to the day camp experience. Campers ages 5-10 are welcome! Day Camp won't take place on the shores of Loon Lake, but we are excited to branch out across the Diocese of Green Bay to welcome more families into our Camp Tekakwitha community. Come join us! A week of Day Camp begins with a drop-in family event on Sunday evening and then runs Monday through Thursday from 8 AM to 4 PM for campers ages 5-10.
